desc: Repeated water freeze-thaw cycles driven by Arctic cold crack rock along grain boundaries, replacing blasting and grinding
Throwaway pykrete (ice plus sawdust) hulls or slabs built on winter river ice carry ore concentrate down the spring flood, then are left to melt
Freezing a dilute leach solution or brine pushes salts out of the ice, so metals are concentrated almost free before shipping
Underground leaching of a thawed, bounded ore block, with the surrounding permafrost acting as a self-sealing container
Sprayed ice trough with steel-runner sleds pulled by an endless cable loop, like a ski lift, for continuous low-friction freight
Driverless sled trains pulled across tundra and sea ice by wind-traction kites
Heavy-lift airships or hybrid buoyant craft fly concentrate straight from the deposit to a railhead or port with no ground infrastructure
A small modular nuclear plant or stranded gas powers on-site smelting or refining, so only metal or high-value product is shipped
Energy is "exported" as data: stranded gas or coal powers on-site data centres or crypto mining instead of being transported
Stranded gas is turned on site into ammonia, methanol, hydrogen or synthetic fuel, then shipped by small tanker or drone
Cold-adapted microbes leach metals from heaps or from ore in place
Pneumatic or slurry capsule pipelines laid on the surface or under the ice move solids without roads
